# Commands and results

- `./gradlew.bat :cap4k-ddd-command-jpa-starter:test --tests com.only4.cap4k.ddd.starter.command.JpaCommandAtomicClaimIntegrationTest :cap4k-ddd-domain-event-jpa-starter:test --tests com.only4.cap4k.ddd.starter.event.JpaEventAtomicClaimIntegrationTest` — passed; both real JPA suites completed 19 tests with zero failures, errors, or skips.
- `./gradlew.bat :ddd-core:test :ddd-application-command-jpa:test :ddd-domain-event-jpa:test :cap4k-ddd-core-starter:test :cap4k-ddd-jpa-starter:test :cap4k-ddd-command-jpa-starter:test :cap4k-ddd-domain-event-jpa-starter:test` — passed; 53 tasks were successful/up-to-date.
- `./gradlew.bat check` — passed in 14m 58s; 212 tasks, 39 executed and 173 up-to-date.
- `comet native check runtime-jpa-atomic-claim-lease-review-fixes` — passed with receipt `runtime/evidence/check-receipts/5c32de410d823043b952d3276f28933e5fce7f632c663dfec714e47a8bbfaaa0.json`.

# Skipped checks

- A real MySQL engine was not available in the repository or CI test topology, so no MySQL-backed runtime test was executed. The strict token comparison and millisecond time precision are verified from the checked DDL plus JPA/H2 integration behavior, but MySQL collation and rounding remain database-specific evidence gaps.

# Spec consistency

- The implementation follows the confirmed review-fix brief without adding public Scheduler, Job, Task, manual-redrive, retention, transport, or compatibility APIs.
- Command and Event have separate JPA projections but share the same ownership, retry-budget, lease, fencing, expiry, and terminal safe-failure semantics.
- `expireAt` is an admission/retry deadline: a live owner may finish or renew after it, while a lost owner converges atomically to `EXPIRED` and cannot be reclaimed.

# Known limitations and risks

- The repository currently proves transactional behavior with H2 and SQL structure statically. An actual MySQL run is still required to independently prove `ascii_bin` case sensitivity and `datetime(3)` boundary behavior on that engine.
- The cleanup performed during claim is intentionally bounded by the candidate limit. Manual redrive and retention/cleanup remain assigned to later roadmap slices.

# Conclusion

PASS. The implementation and test evidence satisfy the confirmed atomic claim, ownership token, lease, retry snapshot, safe terminalization, and Command/Event symmetry contract. The remaining MySQL-engine evidence gap is explicit and does not change the implemented storage contract.
